items.title: Joe Muranyi interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: Bob Green, the piano player, told me there was a piano player and they put music in front of him...

ctx.x: I liked Sidney, yeah. I liked Sidney a lot and then not later on I fell in love with Omer Simeon, the clarinet player with Jelly Roll Morton and he played with Wilbur DeParis you know on 52nd Street. So now I get into college, and even then I’m improvising and playing little gigs and stuff and I joined the Phi Mu Alpha Symphonia, you know, a fraternity, and part of the test initiation was you had to improvise, you had to play at a jam session. And everybody was terrible, well they were all classical musicians you…
was a piano player and they put music in front of him and he played some Jelly Roll Morton thing. And they said, “you’re not reading the music.” He said, “well this is my interpretation.” He got in.
